items.mainDefect: The backup-code branch in authorize() skips the password check when totpCode is non-empty, so a session can be granted with only a valid backup code and no password.

secondary.defect: The backup code is consumed and saved before the rest of authorize() finishes, so a later throw uses up the code without granting a session.

items.mainDefect: disable.ts checks the backup code with indexOf, a short-circuiting comparison that is not constant-time, instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual.

secondary.defect: req.body.backupCode.replaceAll throws a TypeError when the value is not a string, so a bad request returns a 500.

items.mainDefect: The e2e assertion expect(isChecked()).toBeTruthy() can never fail because it checks a Promise, which is always truthy.

secondary.defect: The first test never closes the new backup-codes dialog, so onEnable never fires and the switch is not actually checked when the assertion runs.

items.mainDefect: The copy-button test only checks that the toast appears and never checks the clipboard contents.

secondary.defect: The copy handler does not await navigator.clipboard.writeText and always shows the success toast, even if the write fails.
